subject: Vendor onboarding: PO issuance flight path & line-item curation
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura@streamlineops.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick - PO number and spend cap for onboarding

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. We're ready to move forward but need a provisional PO and confirmation on how spend caps will be split. A few details from our side:

- Anticipated first-year spend: $250,000 USD (may be quarterly-bursty around Q1 launch).
- We have three SKUs to be tracked on the PO (see short list below) and need them mapped to your ledger line items: STREAM-API, STREAM-EMBED, STREAM-SUP.
- Our billing team asked for a PO number and preferred invoice cadence (monthly or net-30).

I've attached the completed onboarding_form.pdf (filled but we left the PO number blank). Can you confirm:
1) Whether Redwood can issue a provisional PO so we can start provisioning capacity next week?
2) How you handle spend caps across quarters (do you split evenly or allow burst credits)?
3) Any line-item naming conventions we should use to avoid later rework?

If you can route the provisional PO to billing@streamlineops.com and give a tentative PO id, we can begin provisioning.

Appreciate the quick turnaround—we're on a tight launch schedule.

Best,
Laura Chen
VP Partnerships, Streamline Ops
billing@streamlineops.com

Attachment: onboarding_form.pdf (1 page)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura@streamlineops.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, logan_wright@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick - PO number and spend cap for onboarding

Hi Laura — thanks for the form and the clear asks. Short answers up front, then next steps:

1) Yes, we can issue a provisional PO to unblock provisioning.
2) We typically split spend caps by quarter unless you request a staggered profile for launch months; we can also set a burst reserve that auto-adjusts against the annual cap.
3) Line-item naming: we prefer canonical ledger SKUs (API-XS, EMB-LITE, SVC-SUPPORT). I'll include mapping below explicitly.

To move fast I've looped in Monica from Procurement and Logan from Finance to finalize the PO id and payment terms. Monica — can you propose a provisional PO id and indicate whether we should use PRV-2026 or a standard PO prefix for Streamline Ops? Logan — any finance gating for a $250k first-year cap?

Proposed mapping (we'll confirm after Monica/Logan):
- STREAM-API -> API-XS
- STREAM-EMBED -> EMB-LITE
- STREAM-SUP -> SVC-SUPPORT

Action items:
- Laura: confirm preferred invoice cadence (monthly vs net-30) and currency (you listed USD).
- Monica: provisional PO id + whether to split quarterly vs custom cadence.
- Logan: GL code to route invoices to + payment-term flag if >$100k.

I'll circulate a provisional PO stub when we have Monica's id.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Head of GTM Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, Laura Chen <laura@streamlineops.com>
Cc: logan_wright@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Dec 2026 11:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick - PO number and spend cap for onboarding

Hey all — procurement details below. Thanks for the context, Laura.

We can issue a provisional PO with prefix PRV-26 and follow up with a formal PO once the onboarding packet is accepted. Proposed provisional PO: PRV-26-0413 (valid 90 days). That should be enough for provisioning.

Recommended spend profile options (pick one):
- Option A (default): split evenly across quarters — $62,500 per quarter.
- Option B (launch-weighted): Q1 = $110k, Q2 = $50k, Q3 = $45k, Q4 = $45k (we'd allocate a burst reserve for Q1).

Line-item corrections / canonical names (please update your onboarding_form to match these to avoid downstream line edits):
- STREAM-API -> API-XS (ledger code: RDW-APIXS-01)
- STREAM-EMBED -> EMB-LITE (ledger code: RDW-EMBLT-02)
- STREAM-SUP -> SVC-SUPPORT (ledger code: RDW-SVCSP-05)

Please attach unit pricing next to each SKU and confirm currency = USD. If unit pricing is not provided we will mark items as misc spend under the provisional PO and reconcile on the first invoice.

Soojin from Onboarding: once Laura returns the corrected form I will generate the provisional PO PDF and route to billing@streamlineops.com. I attached a sample-provisional-po.pdf so you can see the fields we populate.

Procurement action checklist:
- [ ] Laura: resubmit onboarding_form with canonical SKU names and unit prices.
- [ ] Redwood: issue PRV-26-0413 and send to billing@streamlineops.com.
- [ ] Finance: confirm GL code and payment terms.

Monica Patel
Sr. Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: sample-provisional-po.pdf

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, Laura Chen <laura@streamlineops.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Dec 2026 12:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick - PO number and spend cap for onboarding

Thanks Monica — a few finance notes:

- Invoice routing: please direct invoices to aps@redwood.com and cc logan_wright@redwood.com for the first 2 cycles so we can validate GL tagging.
- GL code for Streamline Ops: 5402-Cloud-Services (confirm this on the invoice).
- Payment terms: Redwood standard is net-30. For any supplier with >$100k annual spend we require a short vendor risk sign-off and a vendor banking verification (small form).
- If you prefer monthly invoicing, that is fine — we'll need monthly unit prices on the PO to reconcile.

HubSpot note: Laura, I'll add the provisional PO id to the deal record once Monica pushes PRV-26-0413. HubSpot link: https://hubspot.company/contacts/record/DL-7839

If procurement needs an exception on the vendor verification for quick provisioning, escalate to procurement leadership and mark the PO "provisional - pending vendor verification".

Logan Wright
Director, Finance Operations

From: Laura Chen <laura@streamlineops.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, logan_wright@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Dec 2026 14:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick - PO number and spend cap for onboarding

Thanks everyone — appreciate the rapid responses. Confirming a few things:

- We'll go with Option B (launch-weighted). I updated the onboarding_form.pdf with canonical SKUs and unit prices (USD) and re-attached.
- Invoice cadence: monthly. Billing will send invoices to aps@redwood.com monthly and cc billing@streamlineops.com.
- We confirm unit prices for the three SKUs; please proceed with the provisional PO.

Next steps from Laura / Streamline Ops:
- Send signed onboarding_form.pdf back to Monica by EOD today.
- Once we receive PRV-26-0413 we'll begin provisioning and schedule the initial capacity handoff.

Can someone send the provisional PO stub to billing@streamlineops.com as soon as PRV-26-0413 is created? That will let our provisioning team begin the cloud work tomorrow.

Thanks again — Laura

Attachment: onboarding_form_signed.pdf (updated)
